pillar: AI tools that change marketing work

slides.title: You can now brief Google's ad AI *in German*
slides.subtitle: AI Brief expands to 7 more languages

slides.label: 01 · What changed
slides.title: AI Brief goes multilingual
slides.body: On 23 September, Google expanded the closed beta of AI Brief for AI Max to Dutch, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Portuguese and Spanish.

slides.label: 02 · What AI Brief is
slides.title: A written brief for the machine
slides.body: You guide AI Max *in your own words*, with context on your business, your audience and your key messages. Your strategy now lives in the brief.

slides.label: 03 · New report
slides.title: One view of the whole journey
slides.body: Search term, then the creative the person saw, then the page they landed on. All in one place. Google hasn't given a general availability date yet.

slides.label: 04 · The catch
slides.title: Still a closed beta
slides.body: Not every account will see AI Brief yet. Treat it as a test: keep a control period and compare results before and after.
